scope: Read-only local algorithmic diagnosis of candidate B final wall-to-roof seam; not an actual B portable export or native repair
method: Inline Python AST extracts only constants and pure numerical functions. SHA-pinned real R7 GLB provides the true Saddle cut loop. Float32 reconstructed B four rings and 261 roof boundary points reproduce the final 773-face strip; no Blender/CDT/provider operation or geometry file write. AABB candidate filtering plus SAT, followed by independent segment-triangle interior witnesses.

causalEvidence.explanation: Wall samples and heights use semantic u=i/512 on the original roof perimeter; zipper reparameterizes the already displaced ring by its new XZ arclength. The resulting correspondence shifts along the sharply varying roof height, causing actual final-strip faces to intersect. This is not merely a rotated west seam, shadow/material issue or SAT epsilon artifact.

inMemoryOnlyAB.change: Use semantic ring u=i/512 and the true roof perimeter u for final strip pairing, instead of arclength recalculated from the sculpted ring.

proposal: Retain an explicit common boundary-u ledger through collar/rings/roof; validate the whole actual native ridge after any repair, including roof-wall and preceding-wall contacts. Preserve all existing source/attribute/closure/apron/collar/PBR guards and require nonadjacent self-hit zero before promotion.
limits: Only final-strip 130 hits independently reconstructed; remaining 200 reported native hits not independently retested here.
